provenance.operatorRationale: The court register is a register of children. Two separate gates read the flag and they read it from DIFFERENT places: `SubscriptionsService.checkIfDefendantMatch` reads the vocabulary built from registerDefendants[0] (defect C31 — whichever defendant is first decides whether any subscription matches at all), and OutboundCourtRegister/index.js:22 filters registerDefendants on isYouthDefendant independently. A hearing can therefore match a youth subscription and then contain no youth to put on the register, or contain one and match nothing. Every variant here is a legal boolean, so all are IN_CONTRACT.
